name: get_overview
description: Overall status now: vehicles by state, store deliveries so far, pending twin recommendations, active incidents, KPIs and the top things to watch.

name: list_risks
description: Ranked list of what needs attention now (pending recommendations, late or over-temperature vehicles, dispatch issues in the next two hours, incidents, stock running out, facility alarms), with proposals where something can be done.

name: get_vehicle
description: Where one vehicle is and what it is doing: next stop with planned and estimated arrival, delay, cargo temperature, load, related recommendations and dispatch issues.

id.description: Job or vehicle id such as M02 or DS-BEV-1

name: list_late
description: Vehicles running late now, recommendations about predicted late arrivals, and planned late arrivals from the dispatch board.

name: get_stock
description: Store stock per product family (twin estimate and actual), sales per hour, hours until sold out, and stock-out recommendations.

fams.description: Product family keys; empty = families at risk

name: get_doors
description: Distribution center dock doors: usage now and in the next hour, yard waits, door conflicts, or the bookings of one door.

door.description: Door id such as C05 or D12

name: get_facility
description: Status of one facility (port, airport, distribution center, store receiving) from the facility monitor, plus its upcoming jobs.

name: list_cards
description: Pending twin recommendation cards with the recommended option and its simulated outcome, and recently handled cards.

name: explain_card
description: Explain why the twin recommends an option: every option with its simulated late, over-temperature and stock-out minutes, extra cost and total score.

name: what_if
description: Simulated outcome of a different option for a recommendation card (default: doing nothing), the twin versus no twin comparison so far, or an ad-hoc disruption (a vehicle, liner, train or flight late by N minutes, a dock door closed for a period, a road closed) run through the field model against the same day without it: late, over-temperature, stock-out and door-wait minutes and cost; read-only.

name: propose_decision
description: Prepare approving (with an option) or rejecting one or more recommendation cards. Returns a proposal that a person must confirm; nothing is executed by this tool.

name: get_kpi
description: Planned KPIs from the dispatch board and field results so far with and without the twin.

name: list_incidents
description: Active road incidents, recent vehicle faults and pending breakdown or temperature recommendations.

name: get_schedule
description: Jobs departing or arriving in a time window (seconds since midnight).

name: shift_handover
description: Shift handover report: results, what happened, open items and what the next shift should watch.

name: review_recommendations
description: Review of handled recommendations: predicted versus actual outcome, adoption and hit rate by kind.

name: get_forecast
description: Forecasts from the selected models (rule versus learned, picked by validation error): store demand per product family, liner and train delays, road travel time.

name: plan_network
description: Multi-store network plan for the current region: which distribution centers to open or expand, cost per year versus today, vehicles and km per day, with the reasons.

name: get_crossborder
description: Cross-border inbound flows: clearance time per mode consistent with the simulation, inspection rates, required documents, declarations per year and exchange-rate sensitivity of landed cost.

name: optimize_dispatch
description: Solve dock-door assignment and vehicle scheduling for the day (exact branch and bound or a proven bound) and propose applying the solution to the dispatch board.

name: search_knowledge
description: Search the procedures and design documents and return matching passages with their source.

name: help
description: What the assistant can do, with example questions.

name: explain_delay
description: Root cause of lateness: for one vehicle, how many minutes behind plan it is and why (departure, door wait at the distribution center, loading, breakdown, road incidents, slower traffic, dwell, store dock wait, dispatch holds, warehouse queues), minute by minute so the parts add up; without a vehicle, the store-level breakdown of late arrivals so far.

name: detect_anomalies
description: Anomalies so far (only data up to now): 15-minute increments of late, over-temperature, stock-out, door-wait, dock-wait minutes and twin cost compared with the previous 3 hours (EWMA baseline, robust z-score), twin ETA error, warehouse zone occupancy over 85% or sudden jumps, and open KPI board alerts, each with a time window and likely cause.

name: get_hub
description: One warehousing hub now (port logistics center, airport cargo terminal, logistics park, store parking and receiving yard): every zone with occupancy versus capacity, queues, KPIs and our own cargo in it.

name: trace_own_cargo
description: Where our own cargo (containers, ULDs, pallets) is across the hubs: steps done, current step, next step, and the onward job from the dispatch board.

id.description: Container, ULD or job id; empty = all of our cargo

name: hub_bottlenecks
description: Bottlenecks of one or all hubs over the day plan: fullest zones with the windows over 85% of capacity, longest dwell, queue peaks, and whether appointment smoothing would help.

name: plan_appointments
description: Appointment smoothing for a hub: shift arrival windows of trucks that arrive later than the lead time (reefer at most 30 minutes, others 60) to flatten the dock queue under door capacity and cold-chain limits; returns a proposal to notify carriers (a person confirms) with before/after queue peak and waiting minutes, computed with the yard scheduler when the site yard plan is available (store receiving yard), otherwise with the first-come-first-served queue model; the answer names the model.

name: daily_plan
description: Today's plan for the morning meeting: store arrivals, vessels/flights/trains, busiest door and dock hours, staffing hint, risks with forecasts, and known open issues.

name: get_data_quality
description: Data channel quality now (drop rate, late messages, longest gap), twin ETA error, and what that means for the answers and proposals.

name: get_policy
description: The guardrails: who may execute or approve what (by role and cost), hard constraints (cold chain, batch size, appointments) and the human-confirmation rule.
